title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend protest march in London | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a protest march in London on 11 August 1971.

They had been filmed in and around London prior to joining the march, for a project with the working title Your Show. In the afternoon they went to the opening of art exhibition Art Spectrum at Alexandra Palace.

Afterwards they went to Marble Arch, where they joined a protest march through the streets of central London in protest against Britain’s internment of Northern Irish terrorists and the sentences handed down to the editors of Oz following their obscenity trial.

Lennon and Ono were photographed during the march, with Lennon holding a copy of Red Mole with the front page headline “For The IRA Against British Imperialism”.
